introduction: M Street Navigation Center offers shelter and support for adults experiencing homelessness in Kern County. Start with coordinated entry to ask about placement rather than assuming a bed is available.

who: The center serves unsheltered adults age 18 and older. Placement and available beds require intake; men and women sleep in separate dormitory areas.
sections.get: Services include shelter, meals, laundry, secure storage and connections to medical, mental health, housing and employment support. Canine kennel support depends on availability and rules.
sections.docs: Explain your location, shelter need, accessibility needs and whether a dog is with you. Ask intake about transport, registration and belongings before travelling; prohibited items and storage rules apply.
sections.apply: Call 211 and ask to connect with Kern County Coordinated Entry System intake staff. CAPK’s center FAQ explains this referral route.
sections.after: Follow the intake and arrival instructions. Tell staff about health or safety needs and ask how to meet a housing navigator. Shelter admission is separate from permanent housing approval.
